structured_output.summary: Removed the duplicated playerInputs helpers. tests/game/six-car-race.test.ts and tests/game/six-car-grid.test.ts are both new in tonight's diff, so editing them is allowed. Added a new tests/game/helpers.ts that exports twinPlayerInputs(trackId, seed, carCount, maxTicks). It is built on the existing botsFor from tests/sim/helpers.ts, so neither file maps createBot inline any more. It runs the same loop as before (bot inputs for car 0 of a twin world, stepped until car 0 finishes or maxTicks is reached) and keeps the grid file's check that car 0 finished. Both files now call it, with FIVE_MINUTES in the race test and TEN_MINUTES (the old 60*60*10) in the grid test. Their local copies and the unused imports (createBot, stepWorld, CarInput, getTrack) are gone. The one change in behaviour is that the race test now also checks the twin's car 0 finished, which its AC5 test already requires, so no outcome changes. No src/ changes. pnpm typecheck passes, and pnpm test passes: 77 files and 600 tests, including all 10 six-car tests. This is a duplication fix, so there is no red/green test. ESLint couldn't be run in the sandbox because it isn't installed locally and there's no network.
